## Verdict

**CLEAN_DISPATCH.**

Both payloads are UTF-8, have a final LF, and contain no CR bytes.  The
request binds the exact reviewed L14--L20 report and supplies the complete
accepted conditional-source context.  It retains the arbitrary finite
complex-row quantifier, the exact physical measure `W r* p_t`, the cutoff
boundary, conditional-law variation, nonlinear likelihoods, and the mixed
term.  It requests an actual transfer or a precise failure of a specified
transfer; it does not promote the scalar renewal budget to `E_loss`, `V`, or
RH.

The excluded scalar-Lipschitz and raw all-k monotonicity shortcuts remain
excluded, while a source-derived weighted estimate is correctly treated only
as a resource.  Delivery and response paths are scoped to one result in the
existing phase/chat.
